text: They deserve 0 stars. They accept orders, keep extending the delivery date repeatedly, and then cancel the order at the last moment, claiming there was a technical issue, and they couldn't deliver it. If you can't fulfill orders, why promote your app at all? This has been one of the worst shopping experiences I`ve ever had. Very disappointing. I have not received my prepaid amount and the freedom sale discount coupons are also wasted.
author: Ritu Gupta

text: Worst app ever! Cheap-quality products, poor customer support, and what they show on the app is completely different from what you receive. They even send products without tags, then reject returns claiming there’s no tag. If the product was received without a tag, how is the customer responsible? They offer no proper solution, leaving you with a low-quality product and wasted money. Highly disappointed! I don’t even want to give you 1 star. If there were an option, I would give you zero stars—
author: Arpita Sarkar

text: I am using the app for months and I have made several orders through this app. But in that more than 70% order not delivered in time or cancelled by their end. Compared to other online Shopping apps, the AJIO is very poor and they do not feel guilty and. ot trying to improve the service. We can see Swiggy or blinkit etc., they are delivering items 15 min or less in groceries and Flipkart is delivering orders almost same day or next. But Ajio is not trying to pack my order after 5 days also.
author: Manickavasagam Ramachandran

text: I love the app! 🥰 It's amazing to see how much the latest update has improved things. Downloads are significantly faster, stability is better, and everything feels more reliable. Huge thanks to everyone behind the algorithms! Earlier, syncing happened almost every time I used the app, causing it to freeze until synchronization ended. Every stopped entry also gained several unnecessary seconds, making the previous experience frustrating.
author: Refer Code: JIT3QO2KW (599फ्री)

text: Very poor customer service. I placed an order on 24th July which was supposed to be delivered by 3rd August. But today 30th July when I checked my order status it was showing order cancelled & refund initiated. If there was no stock or some other issue you could have shown in the app no stock or not deliverable while placing order. Why did it took you 6days to notice the issue. What if it is for some urgent purpose & you do this in last moment. Very bad. I am disappointed. It's because of price.
author: Dolagobinda Dash

text: One of the things that annoys me is that it doesn't have a proper review system, we can't see reviews from real people or have a glimpse of how the product actually looks and it takes days for the order to arrive. However the return system is pretty good 👍🏼 The cash credits in your account almost instantaneously, although it takes multiples returns and reorders to get fixed on a product
author: ABIN George BCR332

text: I used it 2 times to place orders every time I order something they miss something. The first time when i placed an order and returned the item they took 4 months to refund and the second I ordered 2 necklaces they shipped only one item and they are requesting 7 days just to check for eligibility of the refund. Do not use this app.
author: Bhanu Charan

text: The app and the products are good. But the delivery experience has been horrible. Some items are missing, delivery happens a month after placing the order. Overall a frustrating experience. After complaining about the missing items and requesting for a return, there has been a horrible response with a msg popping up every 2 days that says "glad you changed your mind about the return". I didn't. You changed your mind about the pick-up. Uninstalling the app.
author: Shirley Maria

text: I should say that initially the app was performing pretty well. However, the service of ajio has drastically gone down to a point where they would cancel prepaid orders without prior notice to the customers, orders which are specifically on heavy offers at unbelievable prices. Yes that's what is happening. It's not the first time with me. They would basically recover that cancellation by giving you a so-called special coupon provided, you have to spend double to use the coupon.
author: Kevi Belho

text: The interface is bit boring to begin with, no customer reviews, and we can barely save 50 products in our wishlist unlike other apps which lets us wishlist 500-1000 products. There's no exchange, the items won't get exchanged on any addresses, you have to return the item, then place another order, which will also take another platform fee. Such a scam. It's so hassling to order. That's why people seldom order from this app. This app is a nightmare to be sure.
author: Varsha S

text: Don't fall for their promotional offers! I downloaded the app because they advertised ₹1,000 cashback and ₹500 off on the first order. While the ₹500 instant discount worked fine, the promised ₹1,000 cashback was never credited even after waiting for over 2 months. I reached out to customer support multiple times, but there was zero proper response or resolution. Extremely disappointing experience—worst app ever. Save yourself the hassle! Even when I call them at support they go on say will be
author: Jayanth mani Manikumar

text: I deeply regret shopping from this app. Never order anything from this platform. Once you place an order, you can't cancel it even if you want to. On top of that, there is no Cash on Delivery (COD) option available—you have to pay online in advance. When I confirmed my order, the estimated delivery date was 6 days later. But when the 6th day arrived, the delivery was delayed by another 3 days. This is the worst shopping platform I've ever used. 🤮
author: Sunil Dawar

text: I am extremely disappointed with my experience ordering from Ajio. I placed orders three times, and every single time, I received the wrong product—and of poor quality, at that. Although I submitted return requests and the items were collected, I never received a refund. Calling the helpline provides no assistance either. How long is a customer supposed to wait for a refund? With other apps, the refund is processed either on the same day the delivery person picks up the item or the very next day
author: Barkha Shukla

text: Never trust them. This is the second time they have failed to deliver the product within the timeline they committed to. They keep giving one revised timeline after another, and eventually cancel the order themselves. Their customer service is also very poor. They only keep listening to their own side and never provide any proper solution. Overall, it has been a very bad experience.
author: GAUTAM SINGH

text: Very disappointing experience with AJIO. I placed an order and made a prepaid payment, but I received only one parcel instead of my complete order. I immediately contacted AJIO customer support and raised a complaint, but my issue was marked as “resolved” even though it was not resolved. I was also denied a refund despite not receiving the complete order. It is extremely frustrating to make a prepaid payment and then have to repeatedly contact customer support for items I have already paid for.
author: maaz shaikh

text: Bad quality products with a higher price. Return process is very lengthy. Not expected :( Ordered Kurta Set from Ajio twice and 1st one was very poor in fabric and the 2nd one is from e different brand which is shown is the app and also the fit is horrible and while I tried returning the product, they asked to send photos of the product again and again. Return process is very lengthy. And currently I had to contact them and mail them for just a return 👎👎 Not at all satisfied!
author: mithu mukherjee

text: Ajio no longer seems to care about its customers. Last time I placed an order, some of the orders got cancelled without any satisfactory reason. And this is not 1st time, many times I've faced the same issue. Another issue, the expected delivery takes a longer time to deliver. Customer service is not good. This time, they delivered the wrong size of footwear. I really liked the footwear, so I order for an occasion, product is out of stock now. Unfortunately, I have to return this.
author: Reena Kumari

text: My experience with AJIO was really unacceptable. I had ordered 4 items from this platform and the first item I received had a missing item for which I contacted the customer care and no help was provided. The 2nd item couldn't be delivered and they returned it from their side and in the app its mentioned as I requested a return after so much wait for the item itself . This is the most pathetic online shopping app I've ever shopped from. I'm forced to escalate it further at this point.
author: Adarsha Suresh

text: I placed 2 orders till now and my experience is too bad. The first order was cancelled by me and they still delivered it.again for return I had to pay them an amount which made my experience worst. For second order i had ajio wallet cash. I didn't even place the order and the cash disappeared. They are not at all taking any accountability. I have called atleast4 time and they are always asking to wait 48 hours .Worst app ever. if there were -ve ratings I would have given this lowest of -ve.
author: tripti chaudhary

text: One of the worst shopping apps I have ever used. I would suggest that anyone who orders multiple products from this app make an unboxing video for their own safety and as proof. They may miss one of your products when you order more than one item. This was my first and last order from this app, and I have already uninstalled it. I lost my hard-earned money because of their mistake. already reached your customer care with no help. that's another worst experience.
author: Ramya Menon

text: A very very bad experience I would suggest everyone not shop from this app. It is a very poor and frustrating platform. Refunds take far too long, and sometimes incorrect items are delivered. Even for returns, if the brand tag is missing, customers are asked to share images via email, which is inconvenient. On other apps, returns and refunds are often processed instantly. Jio's policies are extremely disappointing and need significant improvement.
author: Naresh Parmar

text: there is no customer support where you can talk. just a fixed menu of clickable options in the name of customer support. absolutely useless. they delivered the product without the box and now the delivery partner is refusing to take the return saying that the box is missing. how can I can I return the box of i didn't recieve, it's not shown as a part of the product either while purchasing. there is no redressal on their App either. emailing the customer support is also useless
author: Akanksha Gupta

text: My request has still not been resolved after requesting multiple times. I ordered a particular product. Ajio delivers some unknown brand's product the size of which is also not right. Now you guys neither refund the product not exchange it. I've been trying for the last 15 days. This is terrible customer service and is unexpected from a "brand" like Ajio. This is all you reply "don't worry" and literally do nothing about it. I'm uninstalling the app.
author: Rachita Swain

text: Absolute nightmare—do not trust this platform. I placed two separate orders on Ajio, and both times they delivered completely wrong products. To make matters worse, there is no functional way to return them. Their customer support chat abruptly closes out before you can even submit a complaint. It feels less like a reputable marketplace and more like a platform for sketchy merchants to cheat customers. Save your money and shop elsewhere.
author: Jayakanth Therain

text: Giving 1 star as I cannot give a negative. Worst ecom app ever. First of all, the quality of the products apart from a few brand are utter waste. Very cheap quality clothes and all are see-through. So I had returned almost all of the items from that order(totally 7 returned) among which 4 have been updated as picked up by the delivery agent and the rest 3 is in the same status I.e., "item to be picked up by June 22 (even on June 24th) when the items have already been picked up on 13th of June.
author: Amruthavarshini R G

text: Poor wishlist experience. Many items added to my wishlist frequently show as out of stock, and there is no clear indication of when they will be available again. It is frustrating to save products for later and then find that they cannot be purchased. AJIO should improve stock management and provide restock notifications for wishlist items.
author: Shubham Kumar

text: Very bad experience. I ordered something and they cancelled the order 5 days after it was confirmed. There was no compensation, no price difference payment or anything. I asked them to send it to me again but they told me I had to buy it at the higher price it was being sold afterwards. There is no one answering the customer care number and their chat agent just says "We understand your disappointment". Would not recommend.
author: Silky Patwa

text: Warning: Do not order from this app! App is fine, but delivery partners are so bad. Order reaches local hub on time, then takes forever to deliver, and customer support either won't answer or provide generic response "please wait another day or two". That's it, first n final order from ajio, that too if it gets delivered at all. Then uninstalling, won't ever use it again. I already had 4 calls with your customer support in last 24hrs, not calling again. Thank you for the Reply!
author: dark spark

text: Pathetic service and the worst shopping experience I've ever had. My return was picked up over 20 days ago and has already reached your warehouse. Even your customer care team confirmed this, yet the Ajio app falsely shows it's not updated. My refund is still pending. Every call ends with "wait 2 more days," while complaints are closed without my consent and reopened. Multiple emails have been ignored. If negative ratings were possible, I'd give one. Refund my money immediately.
author: Koushik Mohan

text: Very poor customer service. I placed an order on 12th July which was supposed to be delivered by 21st July. But today 18th July when I checked my order status it was showing order cancelled & refund initiated. If there was no stock or some other issue you could have shown in the app no stock or not deliverable while placing order. Why did it took you 6days to notice the issue. What if it is for some urgent purpose & you do this in last moment. Very bad. I am disappointed.
author: Prathiksha G

text: Worst experience ever. Almost every order has had an issue, from missing price tags,brand logo, wrong size and damaged items to return delays. I still haven't received the refund for one of my returned orders from June .Every time I have to explain the entire issue to customer support again and the process is never smooth.Pathetic. No other shopping app has been this frustrating."Worst app, quality check issue, refund scam....Uninstalled it"
author: Prajakta Tribhuwan

text: worst app I have ever used in my life. Services are pathetic, can't tell what I face. 1st they don't have a customer review system to see and buy. 2nd mostly their product materials are very poor. 3rd if you didn't like and wish to return then Oh God it's done. no one will ever pick your return, you have to accept it whether you like it or not. so choose wisely, we use online shopping apps for their fast and easy services but AJIO don't count as one. wasted so many days just for a return. WORST!
author: Niha Tasnim

text: This is one of the worst shopping apps I have ever used. The delivery service is extremely poor, and customer support is completely unhelpful. My order reached my state, but instead of delivering it, they sent it to another state for no reason, causing unnecessary delays. The tracking updates are confusing, and no one provides a proper explanation. Customer care either gives automated replies or does not respond with a useful solution. This has been a very frustrating experience.
author: Vinay Raghav

text: I received wrong product, despite sharing clear photos, they insisted it was correct. They delayed the return until the window closed, forced me to keep it. Customer support via calls and emails was useless. No resolution, poor service, and now I'm blocked from ordering and they are saying it’s an automated block which can't be cleared and asking me to create a new account with a new number, should i really take another sim to order. Completely unreliable app. I no longer wanted to use this app.
author: Revathi Madireddy

text: Very disappointing experience. My order was delayed multiple times, delivery attempts were falsely marked, and I had to chase the delivery partner myself. Eventually, the order was cancelled, and when I raised a complaint and asked for compensation, I was given a useless coupon instead of a proper resolution. Poor customer service and a complete waste of time.
author: Anand Singh

text: This is a very pathetic app. I have been receiving wrong items 3 times in a row. I order something else, and receive something completely different; the parcel gets changed inside. Who is responsible for this, the seller or the delivery partner? Please fix this. I had to face a lot of trouble to return it. They do not deliver genuine products and pack fake items instead.If there was a zero-star option, I would have given it.
author: JIAH SINGH

text: Don’t use this app—it’s a waste of time purchasing products. When you try to return an order, the pickup partner takes much longer than expected, and even after several days, they don’t show up. They don’t answer calls either. Contacting Ajio customer care is also frustrating—they promise resolution within three days, but it never happens....
author: merugu praveen

text: Extremely disappointing experience with Ajio. This is not a one time issue I have repeatedly received incorrect or missing items in my orders. In my most recent order, the products were completely missing. Despite raising complaints for over two weeks, customer service has neither acknowledged the issue properly nor provided any effective resolution. The process is frustrating and time consuming, requiring multiple follow ups just to receive a response, with no guarantee of a solution.
author: AfhamKidwai KGB

text: Very Poor Experience – Not Reliable at All I had a really bad experience with this app. I ordered a product that had a size issue, so I placed a return request. It has been almost 1 month, and the pickup has still not been done. Also, I ordered another product twice. The first time, it was automatically marked as unsuccessful without any reason. When I ordered it again, it has been delayed for almost a month now. On top of that, one of my orders was showing “out for delivery,” but after 5 days,
author: SHIVAM CHAUHAN

text: Very disappointed with AJIO's service and customer support. I ordered a set of 4 underwears from seller Royal Taylor, but received only 3; one item was missing from the package. Unfortunately, there is no replacement option available for this order. I also tried to report the issue, but it was extremely difficult to contact customer care. This has been a very frustrating experience. I expected better service from AJIO and more accountability from the seller.
author: Suryakant Yadav

text: Extremely frustrated with Ajio's delivery service. My order was supposed to be delivered days ago, but they keep pushing the delivery date back every single day. There is absolutely no proactive communication about the delay, and customer care only gives automated, useless responses. If you cannot deliver items on time, stop giving fake estimated dates at checkout.
author: Kannam Meghana

text: I purchased shoes from Ajio, but when I received them, they were very uncomfortable and not suitable to wear. I decided to return the product, but the app showed that the item was not eligible for return. When I contacted customer care, they told me that I had used a coupon, due to which the product was non-returnable. However, I clearly did not use any coupon while placing the order. This is very disappointing and unfair. Customers should be clearly informed about such policies before purchase.
author: Swadha Singh

text: Worst app. Nothing works in this application properly. I ordered a few products and later wanted to cancel it as I wanted to change delivery address. Even after cancel, when I open orders it's not cancelling and going to ship. And I received a different product from them in a different order. When I tried returning the agent said that he can't as it's a different product as the color is different. After contacting support to raise complaint..she cancelled return from her side, but its not cancel
author: Manasvi A H

text: I had a terrible experience with the AJIO app. I ordered a pair of pants, and when the delivery finally arrived, the size was completely wrong and much bigger than expected. That was already frustrating, but what made things worse was the return process. When I tried to return the product and get a refund, I found out that there was no return option available at all. The app only allowed replacement, not a refund.
author: Ayush Kesharwani

text: I'm really disappointed with the service. The sizes of the items I ordered are inconsistent and not true to size. When I tried to exchange them, the exchange option was not available for my selected PIN code, so I was forced to return the items instead. Now my account is showing a high return rate, which is unfair because the issue was not from my side. Kindly look into this matter and help resolve it.
author: Savita Gupta

text: I used to shop a lot from Ajio, I love the quality of their products, but the customer care is the worst, they just don't resolve any problems...I was facing a COD option disabled issue, and contacted the customer care, they said they will look into it but no response, I contacted them 2 to 3 times. I decided to delete my account permanently, but my account got blocked when I tried to join in again from the same number, this issue is also not resolved by the customer care. This is so badddd
author: Siri

text: I ordered multiple shirts and pants on the app. Some are good, size as expected, for some brands, size is smaller than expected. I wanted to place an exchange. However, it showed the product cannot be exchanged at my location, instead I am forced to return. While creating a return, I am forced to pay the convenience fee. Why?? I am willing to exchange but you are not able to provide that. Customer care service, forget it. Even after multiple messages, they don't respond. This app is a scam!
author: Ayanabha Ghosh

text: I had very bad experience from this app I ordered 2 items . 1 item came entirely different than what I ordered. Another I ordered pack of two it came only 1 for exchanging person denied to pick the product because of same reason they haven't checked seal bill tag with out seeing all this , by only checking the product photo and product is same , how many is there like that they checked and denied the pick up. It's absolutely wrong , waste of time.
author: KEERTHI KRISHNAN

text: This app doesn't deserve even a single star. They deliver items without any brand or price tags, and then repeatedly cancel return requests for that very reason. It's incredibly frustrating, and I’ve noticed that I’m not the only one—many other customers are facing this exact same trap. This is a total waste of time and money. Don't order anything from this app.Even if you contact their customer care, they ask you to email product photos multiple times. Then they make excuses 😡
author: Tannu Anand

text: This is one of the worst online shopping apps I’ve used. The platform lists many sellers that don’t even seem like genuine brands, which raises serious trust issues.There is no proper option to leave detailed reviews or upload photos of products. This makes it difficult for customers to make informed decisions before purchasing.The return policy is also very disappointing. In my case, I received a product without proper branding or packaging, and the return request was denied.
author: Neelu Tiwari
